title: Addressing Endogeneity Using a Two-Stage Copula Generated Regressor Approach
eligible_reason: Econometric methods paper (2sCOPE, IV-free endogeneity correction) with simulations and a price-elasticity application on store-level toothpaste sales. No difference-in-differences design.
design_notes: Empirical application: Dominick's store-level toothpaste category sales, Chicago, 373 weeks 1989-1997, price endogeneity with copula control function. 'Difference-in-difference' appears only in the introduction as an example of quasi-experimental methods. Issue: JMR 62(4), 2025.
screener_notes: Not eligible: no DiD. Application data are the public Kilts Center Dominick's database. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only.
